verdict.rationale: The vendor states it can "add a start and end time to each word in the transcript," which directly matches the story, and results can be retrieved programmatically as JSON through the jobs API. The only evidence, though, is a one-line homepage claim; the API reference excerpts never show the request parameter or the per-word output fields. Missing for 10: API reference documentation of the word-timestamp parameter and response schema, and independent or hands-on confirmation of word-level timing accuracy.
